svg.title: One array in, one .tif out. A plain GeoTIFF has thousands of valid forms, rumi has one
svg.desc: The same array goes into both paths and a .tif comes out of both. Written as a plain GeoTIFF it fans through seven compression choices, three interleave choices and five further switches into roughly two thousand valid files. Written as rumi every switch is fixed, so one path leads to one file.
